title: V3 classic widget with an unregistered widgetType 'not_a_widget' — legacy unknowns are SILENTLY DROPPED on save (not thrown)
_comment: WP-Q01 V3 INVALID fixture (Detailed-Req #5; 14-fixtures-harness.md §1 'NB legacy unknowns DROP, not throw'; 12-error-taxonomy.md §3.1 UNKNOWN_WIDGET_TYPE). A classic widget with an unregistered widgetType 'not_a_widget'. UNLIKE an atomic unknown (which THROWS), a LEGACY/classic unknown is SILENTLY DROPPED on the real save (has-atomic-base.php R2; Validator meta carries silently_dropped:true). Validator::dry_run still surfaces the type problem as UNKNOWN_WIDGET_TYPE with valid:false (VERIFIED live on Elementor 4.1.1) — the harness encodes the DROP semantics in this comment while the authoritative verdict is invalid. prefilter.verdict:defer — the TS pre-filter has no registered-type check and treats classic nodes as deferred (§4). requires.experiments EMPTY → runs on free-only/atomic-off.
